shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a yellow shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat and asks to restart the puzzling account to examine every detail. A man in a purple shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat, and a man in a red shirt sits at the pinboard-end seat.

shots.content: A woman in a yellow shirt and a man in a purple shirt exchange seats; she asks for the specific evidence, and he summarizes the core details.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a purple shirt explains the written evidence in full detail.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the entrance-side window seat.

shots.content: A woman in a yellow shirt answers with a question about the timeline.
